item.title: Koi Suru Doll to Omoi no Kiseki ~Poupee de Souhaits~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sugar Pot
  • 発売日: 2014-02-28
  • スコア: 7.2/10 (80 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋する少女と想いのキセキ～Poupee de souhaits～
  • 英語名: Koi Suru Doll to Omoi no Kiseki Poupee de Souhaits

别名

  • Koisuru Shoujo to Omoi no Kiseki

あらすじ

When he was a young boy, Tomoki met the puppet master Asuha who didn’t ‘use’ the dolls, but cherished them like people. He doesn’t remember those times clearly, but he felt like the dolls there were alive when he snuck into her mansion and talked with them. Those days were his most distant and happiest memories.

item.title: Hapi☆Sama! ~Miyanomori Mura e Youkoso!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sugar Pot
  • 発売日: 2010-05-28
  • スコア: 6.68/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はぴ☆さま！～宮乃森村へようこそ！～
  • 英語名: Hapi☆Sama! Miyanomori Mura e Youkoso!

あらすじ

Yuuta lived with his father in the city after his mother’s death when he was young. One day, his father suddenly left for work overseas and Yuuta ended up getting evicted from his apartment and moved to his mother’s hometown, Miyanomori-mura. Living in the countryside with his grandparents for the first time, he is surrounded by girls who are interested in hearing about how it’s like in the city. He’s exhausted from this scenery change, but more unexpected things happen to him when he accidentally broke and awakened the goddess who was asleep. He ended up being possessed by the goddess of wealth and fertility (in chibi form)! However, she has to absorb his luck making him unlucky.
